description: Removed the `torch.compile(model, dynamic=False)` call from `train.py`. This caused the last few runs (specifically around step 10-15) to crash due to memory errors during the fused optimizer steps, likely because the CPU tensor optimization was being applied to tensors that are no longer needed or allocated incorrectly. The compilation optimization added unnecessary memory overhead that was not supported in this optimization context, but removing it fixed the crash.
